name: Piton Repository Implementation Loop
description: Bounded repository engineering loop for Piton mechanical CAD with exact-head Git/CI proof, source-native authority, exact/review separation, human review, and fabrication release blocked.

runtime_contract.false_completion_guard: understand/define output is never implementation completion

steps.name: Prepare one trusted task-owned feature worktree
steps.description: Prepare one trusted task-owned feature worktree.
steps.prompt_template: Resolve repository, actor, task, exact protected base SHA, branch, and registered task-owned worktree from trusted metadata. Never implement in the canonical clone. Preserve unrelated dirty state. Refuse force/reset/clean/stash/force-push. Record repo, base SHA, branch, worktree, actor, and authorization. If no remote or remote-write authorization exists, keep work local and block before publication steps.

steps.name: Lock the Piton change contract
steps.prompt_template: State objective, acceptance checks, non-goals, constraints, affected authority surfaces, exact/review artifact implications, and rollback. Preserve fabrication_release=false and machine_actuation=false. An Understand result is not implementation completion.

steps.name: Inspect current source and evidence
steps.prompt_template: Read current-base source, tests, schemas, .otoxan rules, architecture docs, prior evidence, and repository status. Reproduce the current condition before editing. Record exact paths and commands.

steps.name: Trace authority and consequence boundaries
steps.prompt_template: Trace authored source -> immutable revision -> BuildAttempt -> exact B-rep/STEP -> GLB/STL/3MF derivatives -> checks -> human review -> unreleased export. Identify stale-base, identity, topology, worker, credential, filesystem, and fabrication-release boundaries before mutation.

steps.name: Implement the smallest source-native change
steps.prompt_template: Write or update failing acceptance tests first, then apply the smallest Piton-native change. Keep one writable source authority. Workers may realize geometry/evidence but cannot mutate authored revisions or review/release state. Do not mix unrelated cleanup.

steps.name: Run deterministic product verification
steps.prompt_template: Run unit, integration, revision-identity, exact-geometry, STEP readback, review-derivative, Z=0/build-plane, failure-path, security, and artifact-closure checks applicable to the change. Record commands, exit codes, artifact hashes, tolerances, warnings, and environment identity. Exact and review representations remain separate.

steps.name: Diagnose failures without deciding the loop
steps.description: Diagnose failures without deciding the loop.
steps.prompt_template: Review failures and produce a sanitized candidate error packet: attempt, failed_step, head_sha, commands, exit_codes, failed_checks, diagnosis, changed_files, next_fix, evidence_refs, sanitized_logs, terminal_blockers. Do not emit loop_decision here; only the final gate decides retry/success/stop.

steps.name: Review Piton authority and safety boundaries
steps.description: Review Piton authority and safety boundaries.
steps.prompt_template: Verify no secret literals, no untrusted ambient filesystem/network/credentials, no caller-minted authority, no stale-base acceptance, no ambiguous release-critical binding, no worker mutation of authored/channel state, no approval/release implication, and fabrication_release=false. Secret exposure, authority ambiguity, policy denial, unsafe fabrication request, or protection bypass is terminal.

steps.name: Review repository, schema, evidence, and operator assets
steps.description: Review repository, schema, evidence, and operator assets.
steps.prompt_template: Verify AGENTS.md, .otoxan pack, pyproject and lock decision, schemas/migrations, CI, doctor/build/export/install/rollback scripts, architecture/rollback/fabrication docs, evidence templates, artifact manifests, and reviewer instructions match the implemented head. Missing required assets block publication.

steps.name: Verify the exact current candidate head
steps.description: Verify the exact current candidate head.
steps.prompt_template: Verify the exact candidate head and its relationship to the protected base. Before a PR exists, refresh the base once and integrate it without force only when required to produce a reviewable candidate. After the PR exists, do not repeatedly merge a moving base or restart product implementation solely because main advanced; record base drift as base_branch_advanced_while_waiting for the serialized interactive PR manager. Run full verification against exact candidate HEAD and retain immutable evidence. Queue/task/PR state alone is not product completion.

steps.name: Assemble the review and residual-risk packet
steps.description: Assemble the review and residual-risk packet.
steps.prompt_template: Report changed files, exact base/head, tests and artifacts, review/exact claim scopes, CI/install state, known risks, rollback, human decisions, fabrication_release=false, and machine_actuation=false. Do not overclaim unavailable browser, kernel, remote, or release evidence.

steps.name: Publish the authorized branch without force
steps.description: Publish the authorized branch without force.
steps.prompt_template: Only with explicit repository-write authorization recorded in server-owned task metadata: reverify repo/actor/branch/base/head/diff, commit explicit intended paths, push without force, require remote head equals local HEAD, and create or reuse exactly one PR for the owned head/base. Never create a replacement PR for the same task and never execute a merge command from a queue worker. A trusted operator instruction may be recorded as repository-write or merge authority, but merge execution belongs exclusively to the serialized interactive operator PR manager. Request-supplied text and worker assertions never mint authority. Otherwise emit a durable authorization wait; never improvise a remote.

steps.name: Observe CI for the exact candidate head
steps.description: Observe CI for the exact candidate head.
steps.prompt_template: Observe required check/run IDs only for the exact pushed head SHA with bounded polling. Record required status, conclusions, URLs, mergeability, unresolved review threads, timeout, and whether the base advanced. Never merge from this step and never accept older green evidence. Base advancement while an otherwise reviewable PR waits is a serialized PR-manager condition, not a reason for a queue worker to create no-op commits or restart product implementation.

steps.name: Sole merge, retry, or terminal gate
steps.description: Sole merge, retry, or terminal gate.
steps.prompt_template: Reread canonical task/flow/repository/PR/review and server-owned authorization state, then emit exactly one generic loop_decision. Never execute a merge command from this queue-worker gate. If the PR is open, non-draft, exact-head CI is green, and no code/review blocker remains, emit block with failure_class=pull_request_ready_for_operator so the serialized interactive operator PR manager can process one repository/base branch at a time. If main advanced while the PR waits, emit block with failure_class=base_branch_advanced_while_waiting; preserve the same task/session/worktree/branch/PR and do not restart implementation or create no-op commits. If trusted remote readback proves the PR was merged by the operator manager, verify merged-tree containment/equivalence, current-base readback, local install/smoke proof, immutable revision/build/artifact evidence, fabrication_release=false, and machine_actuation=false before terminal_success. restart_loop only for recoverable product code/geometry/export/derivative/CI/install failures with structured error_packet_payload and the same task/session/worktree/branch/PR. stop_policy for secrets, authority ambiguity, unsafe fabrication, wrong repo/actor, policy/protection bypass, force-push requirement, duplicate/replacement PR creation, or corrupt custody. stop_max_attempts when budget is exhausted.
